name: Ayzeo GEO – AI Visibility, llms.txt, AI Crawlers and IndexNow
author: ayzeo

sections.description:
Ayzeo GEO is a WordPress plugin for generative engine optimization (GEO): it audits your site for AI search readiness, fixes the issues in one click, serves your llms.txt, writes AI crawler rules into robots.txt and submits new and updated pages through IndexNow. All of this runs on your own server, with no Ayzeo account and no AI service involved.

The Site Audit checks your 20 most important pages by default (you can choose 5 to 100) against 34 checks. The AI crawler rules cover 18 AI crawlers by name, grouped as search, assistant and training crawlers. IndexNow reaches Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep.

With a paid Ayzeo plan or trial, the plugin also tracks AI visibility: whether ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok and Bing AI Mode mention and cite your brand. The GEO overview inside WordPress needs a Pro plan.

Site Audit for AI search readiness

Free and local. Ayzeo picks your most important pages, fetches each one the way a crawler sees it, and checks titles and meta descriptions, heading structure, canonical tags, structured data, Open Graph, author attribution, content freshness, image alt text, mixed content and render blocking. Site checks cover robots.txt, AI crawler access, sitemaps, llms.txt, the AI instructions page, HTTPS, security headers and redirects. Every check is a plain algorithm in PHP on your server. No page content is sent anywhere.

One-click fixes

Where a check fails, Ayzeo offers the fix: JSON-LD structured data built from your own WordPress content, meta description and Open Graph fallbacks when no SEO plugin provides them, and an alt text helper for images. Every fix is previewed first and can be reverted.

llms.txt editor

Write and preview your llms.txt in WordPress and serve it at yoursite.com/llms.txt. With an Ayzeo project, Ayzeo can draft it from a scan of your site. The plugin does not create llms-full.txt.

AI crawler rules in robots.txt

Allow or block each of 18 AI crawlers by name, for example GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended. If your site has a physical robots.txt file, Ayzeo shows the exact block to paste instead of editing the file.

IndexNow for Bing and other search engines

Bing is one of the indexes ChatGPT searches, and IndexNow tells Bing about new, updated and removed pages as soon as you publish them. Ayzeo submits through a background queue with retries and a readable log, generates and serves the key file, and never submits noindex, draft, private, password protected or robots.txt blocked URLs. If Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, SEOPress or Microsoft’s IndexNow plugin already submits, Ayzeo stays off.

AI visibility tracking (with an Ayzeo plan)

Connect the plugin to a project on ayzeo.com and it adds:

  • Deep scans with extra checks and suggested meta tags, JSON-LD and llms.txt content you can apply in one click
  • AI visibility queries: ask a question and see how an AI engine answers it and which sources it used
  • Content pages written for AI answers, saved in WordPress as a draft

GEO overview in WordPress (Pro)

Visibility share, mention rate, citation rate and average mention position, each with the change against the previous seven days, plus sentiment, a trend chart, your competitors ranked next to your brand and your top prompts.

External services

This plugin connects to two external services. Neither is contacted before you switch the corresponding feature on.

Ayzeo (ayzeo.com)

Used only after you save an API token. The plugin sends your token, your site address, the URL of the page you ask it to scan, the question you type into an AI visibility query or a content request and the AI model you pick for it, the number of pages a Site Audit asks for when it ranks your pages, the time window for the GEO overview, and the plugin version. It receives your project details, analysis results and screenshots, suggested content, your top pages from Search Console, your tracked prompts, competitor logos, the current AI crawler list and your analytics. Service provided by Fyrma Inc. See the terms and the privacy policy.

IndexNow (api.indexnow.org)

Used only after you switch IndexNow on. The plugin sends the URLs you publish, update, unpublish or delete, your site host and the IndexNow key it generated for your site. It receives an HTTP status. The endpoint is operated by Microsoft and shares submissions with the participating search engines. See the IndexNow documentation and Microsoft’s privacy statement.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through Plugins, Add New, or upload the ayzeo-geo-seo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Ayzeo, Site Audit and run your first audit. No account is needed.
  4. Open Ayzeo, Indexing and Crawlers to switch on IndexNow and review the AI crawler rules.
  5. For AI visibility tracking, create a project at ayzeo.com, generate an API token in Project settings, API tokens, and paste it under Ayzeo, Settings.
sections.faq:
Is there a WordPress plugin for llms.txt?

Yes. Ayzeo GEO lets you write and preview your llms.txt in WordPress and serves it at /llms.txt, without an account. With an Ayzeo project it can draft the file from a scan. It does not create llms-full.txt.

Can this plugin control AI crawlers in robots.txt?

Yes. One setting writes explicit robots.txt rules for 18 AI crawlers, and you can allow or block each one, for example GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended. A physical robots.txt file gets a paste block instead.

Does one plugin handle llms.txt, AI crawler rules and IndexNow together?

Yes, all three, on a plain WordPress install with no account. IndexNow submits new, updated, unpublished and deleted URLs to Bing, Yandex, Seznam, Naver and Yep. Google does not take part.

Can it audit my site for AI search readiness and fix the issues?

Yes. The Site Audit checks your most important pages and the site as a whole, and offers one-click fixes for structured data, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags and image alt text. Every fix is previewed and can be reverted. A few content checks are rated by the Ayzeo platform and need an account.

What does GEO mean here?

Generative engine optimization: getting your site found, read and cited by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews. Ayzeo GEO is not a geolocation plugin.

Can it show whether ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews mention my brand?

Yes, with a paid Ayzeo plan or trial. Tracked engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok and Bing AI Mode (DeepSeek on request). Which ones a project tracks depends on its plan.

Do I need an Ayzeo account?

Not for the Site Audit, the one-click fixes, IndexNow, the AI crawler rules or llms.txt. An account adds deep scans, AI visibility queries and content pages, and a Pro plan adds the GEO overview.

Does it conflict with Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO or SEOPress?

No. Ayzeo detects them and steps back. If one of them already submits to IndexNow, Ayzeo stays off so you never have two keys. Meta description and Open Graph fallbacks only output when no SEO plugin provides them, and applying a suggested title or description writes into your SEO plugin’s own fields.
sections.changelog:
1.2.4

  • Fixed: the Site Audit no longer offers a fix that is already switched on. The Open Graph and structured data fallbacks give way to the next fix or to advice when a check still fails.
  • New: the meta description fix works on a home page that shows the latest posts, using the site tagline.
  • New: an “Applied fix” button next to a check, so an applied fix can always be reviewed and reverted, also after the check passes.

Older versions: see changelog.txt in the plugin folder.
